title: Family Sari-Sari Store Daily Sales & Credit (Utang) Ledger
summary: Operational retail bookkeeping ledger tracking daily grocery inventory depletion, wholesale markup percentages, daily gross profit, and neighborhood credit (utang) receivables.
problem: Manual paper notebook logging in family micro-retail operations causes unrecorded inventory shrink, missing customer credit payment tracking, and inaccurate end-of-day profit balancing.
whatIDid: Architected an automated daily reconciliation ledger tracking fast-moving household items (canned goods, coffee, noodles, rice, cooking essentials) with beginning and ending stock balances.
Engineered dynamic formula calculations for units sold (=Beginning - Ending), gross sales revenue (=Sold * Retail), gross profit (=Revenue - Sold * Wholesale), and markup percentage.
Formulated dynamic restock alerts (=IF(Ending_Stock<=5, "RESTOCK", "Adequate")) with automated soft red and emerald badge indicators.
Constructed a structured customer credit (utang) reconciliation log tracking original credit amounts, partial settlements, and outstanding receivables balances (=Credit - Paid).
result: Digitized daily micro-retail store tracking from paper notebooks into a structured, formula-automated Excel ledger, eliminating credit discrepancy errors and accelerating daily cash reconciliation [REAL FAMILY BUSINESS WORK SAMPLE].
resultPlaceholder: [REAL FAMILY BUSINESS DELIVERABLE: Built and deployed to manage daily sales, wholesale margins, and credit logs for a family-owned neighborhood retail store]
